function.name: ActorType7E_PlayerCollisionHandler
entry_gates: TERRAIN_PUSH_UP must be set for the transition logic; otherwise the handler clears the scene-resource completion byte and returns through its camera-threshold tail.
The scene-resource completion byte at 0x00FFF114 must be clear before the handler selects a transition.

position_branches.condition: PLAYER_WORLD_X is left of the actor position and INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS is below ASCII 05
position_branches.result: Ensures scene-resource mode 0x11 actors and sets the completion byte when newly instantiated.

position_branches.condition: PLAYER_WORLD_X is left of the actor position and INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS is at least ASCII 05
position_branches.result: If GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER is not ASCII 09, decrements the secondary counter five times, optionally queues audio command 0x48, and increments GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER. At ASCII 09 it selects scene-resource mode 0x16 directly.

position_branches.condition: PLAYER_WORLD_X is at or right of the actor position and INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS is below ASCII 10
PLAYER_WORLD_X is at or right of the actor position and INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS is at least ASCII 10
position_branches.result: Decrements the secondary counter ten times, optionally queues audio command 0x48, advances ACTIVE_SCENE_ENTRY_GATE, and selects scene-resource mode 0x14.

tail_effects: The handler publishes camera thresholds CAMERA_HORIZONTAL_THRESHOLD=0x00B0 and CAMERA_VERTICAL_THRESHOLD=0x0180 before returning.

counter_contract.name: GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER
counter_contract.role: Single ASCII-digit progression/transition counter with an upper cap of '9'.
counter_contract.qualification: The static closure does not assign a user-facing gameplay resource name.

conclusion: ActorType7E_PlayerCollisionHandler uses the secondary interaction counter as a position-dependent transition budget and uses GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER == '9' as the terminal scene-resource selector. This closes the exact static consumer contract while retaining the conservative canonical RAM name.
